_comment: September 2026 Medium security audit, findings F5 and F6. Language-neutral
answer key for the outbound-auth same-origin rule and the X-Forwarded-Host
trusted-proxy gate, across tina4-python, tina4-php, tina4-ruby, tina4-nodejs.
OWED: the per-framework regression tests named below are green (red-first)
in each repo; the shared fail-closed contract runners are not yet wired, so
every invariant is 'owed' until they execute every case ID in all four.
status: owed — per-framework red-first regressions landed; shared runners pending

invariants.given: an Api client configured with base origin A and an Authorization header
invariants.when: a request is made whose resolved target origin differs from A (absolute off-origin path, incl. the userinfo form base@evil/x)
invariants.then: no Authorization and no cookie-jar Cookie header is sent to the off-origin host
the configured Authorization (and cookie jar) is sent (positive twin)

invariants.given: no TINA4_TRUSTED_PROXIES (or a peer not listed in it)
invariants.when: a request arrives carrying X-Forwarded-Host: evil.com
invariants.then: request.url is built from the connection's own Host, never evil.com

invariants.given: the raw socket peer is listed in TINA4_TRUSTED_PROXIES
invariants.when: a request arrives carrying X-Forwarded-Host: app.example.com
